new_jobs.title: Volunteer Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County

Volunteer Program Coordinator

$60,632-$66,019

Annualized Salary

Non-Exempt

About Us:
Come join Second Harvest Food Bank of Santa Cruz County! We are the first food bank in the State of California, and the second in the nation. We pride ourselves in providing 10 million pounds of food annually to over 65,000 people per month through our network of 150-member agencies and programs. We believe that a thriving community is one where everyone has access to nutritious food to support their health and wellbeing. Our team is dedicated to inspiring and supporting our community to provide nourishment for all community members.

Second Harvest seeks to attract and retain a diverse workforce that brings a broad range of perspectives and experiences to our work. We value lived experience alongside learned experience and we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t believe you meet every one of our qualifications. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including

applicants with a criminal history.

About the position:
Working with about 4,000 individual volunteers annually, the Volunteer Program Coordinator (VPC) holds primary responsibility for a comprehensive volunteer program for high school students, college students and adults, in addition to corporate and community groups. Working in collaboration with the Operations and Programs teams, the VPC takes a leadership role in creating and adapting volunteer opportunities that meet the demands of our various operational and programmatic needs, while also ensuring a robust and rewarding experience for volunteers.

REPORTS TO:
Chief People & Culture Officer (CCPO)

SUPERVISES:
Volunteers

Job Summary

Volunteer Management (40%)

Schedule, coordinate, and ensure appropriate number of volunteers are scheduled to complete packaging of food boxes based upon community needs and distribution schedule.
Greet and orient daily volunteers at Second Harvest; providing an engaging experience to all who come.
Connect volunteers with staff and programs needing volunteer support; ensuring volunteers receive appropriate training from their functional supervisor.
Provide technical assistance to volunteers attempting to register or cancel their shifts.
Address complaints and resolve problems involving volunteers.
Act as a liaison between volunteers and staff.
Communicate with volunteers who are not meeting job requirements and address performance issues promptly.
Coordinate with Food Bank staff to identify volunteer opportunities that further programmatic goals and support participants’ needs.
Work with Operations and Programs staff to continually assess and adapt our volunteer opportunities to ensure they are meeting both organizational and volunteer needs.
Vision, pilot and implement necessary program changes.
Serve as the primary point of contact for volunteers at the Food Bank to ensure all volunteers have a positive experience.
Regularly solicit and analyze volunteer feedback for areas of possible improvements.
Steward relationships with Second Harvest’s community of volunteers through volunteer appreciation events and engagement activities. Implement volunteer retention strategies.
Work with food bank staff to ensure that the volunteer experience is consistent with food bank goals and expectations of quality.
Lead planning for our annual Volunteer Appreciation event.
Prepare light refreshments for volunteers from a rotating menu.

Recruit Volunteers for Second Harvest (35%)

Recruit volunteers through a combination of digital and in-person outreach.
Proactively seek opportunities to speak to community groups (i.e., corporations, schools, faith communities, service clubs and organizations) regarding volunteer opportunities at Second Harvest.
Respond to requests from corporate or community groups looking for volunteer experiences or projects.
Regularly identify organizations for potential engagement and work with the
Development team to coordinate efforts as necessary.
Maintain Second Harvest’s volunteer calendar and website with information about upcoming volunteer shifts; ensuring it is accurate and user-friendly.
Promote Second Harvest and volunteerism by regularly attending relevant community events.
Expand and grow our Team-Building Program for corporate and community organizations by making recommendations, piloting and implementing improvements.
Provide tours when Development staff are not available.
Lead occasional workshops and activities for groups to help them deepen their understanding of food banking and food insecurity.
Collaborate with the Development team to identify opportunities to convert volunteers to donors (and vice versa).

Reporting and Storytelling (20%)

Responsible for tracking and reporting volunteer hours in Volunteer Hub.
Coordinate with the Marketing staff to send out a monthly volunteer newsletter.
Develop and maintain the food bank’s volunteer manual and all other literature pertinent to volunteers.
Prepare volunteer reports and materials according to established deadlines.
Document volunteer stories to help spread awareness and support for the food bank and its volunteer program.
Guarantee adequate records for volunteers are securely maintained and up to date.

Other (5%)

Serves as the primary backup for the Receptionist. On days or times when the Receptionist is out of office or otherwise unavailable, the VPC answers the Community Food Hotline, responds to visitors and walk-ins and ensures outgoing mail is taken out.
Ensures the Receptionist is fully cross-trained so s/he can serve as the primary backup for the VPC; covering volunteer inquiries calls and walk-ins when the VPC is on lunch break or out of office.
Serves as a member of the Safety Committee.

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

2+ years of experience coordinating volunteers, community programs, events, or similar activities.
Demonstrated experience recruiting and engaging large numbers of volunteers through multiple channels, including email, phone, social media, community outreach, events, partnerships, and referrals.
Experience developing and maintaining a consistent pipeline of volunteers to meet ongoing staffing needs across multiple shifts, sites, or programs.
Experience building relationships with community organizations, schools, businesses, faith-based organizations, service groups, and other volunteer referral sources preferred.
Experience coordinating logistics for groups, events, programs, or recurring activities.
Experience maintaining accurate records, schedules, and participation data.
Experience using databases, spreadsheets, scheduling platforms, or other systems to track information.
Nonprofit, food bank, social services, community-based organization, or other mission-driven experience preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Ability

Skilled public speaker (whether it’s tabling at a community event, stopping by a local business, or giving a tour); comfortable presenting to groups of all sizes and demographics; able to communicate an inspiring vision of volunteering at Second Harvest
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; whether it’s writing newsletter, emailing with large corporations, or answering volunteer questions over the phone.
Demonstrated ability to track recruitment activity, volunteer participation, vacancies, and other metrics and use data to identify recruitment needs and opportunities.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and drive them to completion by deadline; able to execute on the nitty gritty details while still keeping your eye on the bigger picture.
Skilled at creating engagement and understanding what kind of volunteer recognition is meaningful to different people.
Communicates effectively and respectfully with people from different racial, ethnic and cultural groups and/or different backgrounds and lifestyles; demonstrates a knowledge of and sensitivity to their needs.
Skilled at balancing the needs of the agency and volunteers to match volunteers with the right placement.
Able to work productively in an unstructured environment with frequent interruptions; thrives in a fast-paced environment and can handle the unexpected with a sense of humor and grace under pressure.
Excellent problem-solving skills; ability to juggle multiple (sometimes competing) needs and finding a solution. This can include managing challenging interactions with members of the public and volunteers.
A strong eye for innovation and process improvement; you enjoy the process of conceiving, testing, and piloting new volunteer initiatives.
Experience with the MS Office Suite, particularly Excel. (Experience with Microsoft Teams preferred).
Database management experience (Volunteer Hub a plus).
Knowledge of Santa Cruz County preferred.
Bilingual (Spanish) required. Bicultural preferred.

Additional Requirements

Must have access to a motor vehicle, as well as valid auto insurance coverage.
Must have a valid California Driver’s License and a satisfactory driving record, as documented by a current MVR (will be obtained by the Food Bank’s insurance carrier).
It is the responsibility of all SHFB personnel to participate in our Food Safety/Food Defense programs.
Demonstrate ethical business practices, in conformance with all state and federal laws and regulations.
Commitment to serving vulnerable populations and ending hunger in Santa Cruz County
Demonstrate full adherence to the Code of Conduct and all policies/procedures related to compliance.
Adherence to all applicable federal and state laws and regulations including, but not limited to, those governing confidentiality, privacy, program, billing, and documentation standards.
Ability to meet the following physical requirements with or without reasonable accommodation:
Able to hear conversations on the phone and in-person. The person in this position frequently communicates with volunteers who walk in or call; must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.
Must be able to sit at a desk or in a vehicle for long periods of time to perform certain job functions.
Be able to read, write, and interpret written reports, documents and manuals.
Able to safely lift or carry items weighing up to 20 pounds.
Bi-manual dexterity and able to use a computer keyboard.
Frequent standing and sitting throughout the day.
Occasionally works in outdoor weather conditions.
Use hands to manipulate, handle, feel, and control items or equipment, including laptop computer and motor vehicle.
Climb up or down stairs.
The person in this position needs to frequently walk throughout the facility and warehouse, and to outreach and tabling sites.
Given the front-line nature of our work, there will be instances where staff are required to work a flexible schedule in order to respond to community needs. Advanced notice will be provided.
In instances of a federal, state or locally declared emergency, Second Harvest is considered an essential service and emergency responder; all its employees may be called in to perform regular or emergent duties.

STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE:
The regular schedule for this position is Tuesday-Saturday from 7:30-4:30pm. (Sundays and Mondays off).

Job Details:
This is a full-time, regular, non-exempt position with an hourly rate of $29.15 to $31.74, depending on education and experience

WORKSITE:
800 Ohlone Parkway, Watsonville, CA 95076

WORK FROM HOME:
Not Eligible

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview

This position will design and implement appropriate technical services to ensure that client and project management needs are met. Position includes performing field and office tasks as well as providing project management support for traditional assessment and remediation projects.

Position Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in relevant technical field.
Minimum of 4 years in the environmental consulting industry with demonstrated progression in technical site investigation / remediation and task management.
Proficient in designing field programs and managing projects and associated field activities – scheduling, coordination of tasks, budgeting, subcontractor negotiating/management.
Experience planning, coordinating, and managing Site/Remedial Investigation field activities and performing follow up intermediate hydrogeologic and data interpretation.
Demonstrated task/project management skills.
Intermediate data evaluation and analytical skills.
Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with common technical protocols and regulatory requirements.
Ability and willingness to support the technical growth of staff level professionals based on direct hands-on interactions.

Essential Duties

Field Coordination and Management:
Set up work plans and protocols, supervise field activities, coordinate field personnel and related activities for the purpose of implementing technically sound project plans. May also include implementation of field activities.

Technical Data Review and Report Preparation:
Coordinate the collection and review of project data, including the reduction of field data to evaluate and determine future client needs and project requirements. Interpret data, develop, and finalize a report for Project Manager’s review that appropriately documents findings and project remediation recommendations.

Project Management:
Ensure that individual task schedules, budgets, and client invoicing are monitored and reviewed in compliance with Company standards and client requirements to complete project work.

Staff Mentoring and Training:
Participate in the development of junior staff and work with senior management to continue to grow as a consultant and leader of the firm.

Physical Demands/Work Environment Conditions

This position works in the field as well as the office environment. In the field, candidate will be working independently or leading a larger team at exterior project sites (i.e., industrial/brownfield facilities, monitoring wells, treatment systems, construction projects) to perform sample collection, recording of operational/meter parameters, and oversight of subcontractors (e.g., drillers, heavy equipment operators, truckers). These field activities require the ability to drive to different project sites and physically move around outdoors in various terrains, in adverse weather conditions and occasionally for extended or irregular hours. Conducting work involves the use of hand-held monitoring instruments and tools, as well as water sampling equipment, which requires the ability to routinely lift and carry objects, stand, walk, reach, bend, squat, kneel and twist. Office work is primarily stationary/sedentary using a computer and keyboard/mouse requiring repetitive hand movements.

Roux will take steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the position, please contact HR@rouxinc.com .

Base Salary Range: $85,000 - $115,000. This salary range is based on what Roux in good faith believes it might pay at the time of posting for this position and for this geographic location. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as relevant work experience , market conditions, education /training, certifications, skill sets, and internal equity. new_jobs.description:
Please use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox when accessing Candidate Home.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

What You Need To Know About The Job

As a $3 billion organization with more than 17,000 employees and thousands of dedicated volunteers, the American Red Cross depends on people with diverse backgrounds, skills, and perspectives to advance its mission. Together, we provide relief and support during crises, help communities prepare and respond to emergencies, and ensure access to lifesaving blood and resources.

The Supply Management organization plays a critical role in supporting this mission by ensuring the effective sourcing, delivery, and supplier management of the goods and services the Red Cross depends on every day. Increasingly, our ability to make sound decisions depends on our ability to transform data into timely, accurate, and actionable business intelligence.

The Data Analyst I, Business Intelligence supports this work by collecting, organizing, analyzing and visualizing data to help Supply Management understand performance, identify trends and opportunies, and make better-informed decisions. Working with Supply Management leaders, category teams, business stakeholders and cross-functional partners, this position helps translate business questions into meaningful analysis, reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.

Reporting to the Director of Supply Management Analytics, the Data Analyst I works to strengthen the organization’s use of data and business intelligence. The Analyst supports recurring and ad hoc reporting, develops and maintains dashboards and performance metrics, performs data validation and analysis, and helps turn complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders and leadership.

This is an opportunity for an early-career analyst to develop technical and business intelligence capabilities while gaining exposure to procurement, suppliers, contracts, financial performance, operations, and enterprise decision-making. The successful candidate will bring curiosity, attention to detail, analytical thinking, and an interest in understanding not simply what the data says, but what it means for business and the mission.

The work location for this exciting opportunity is virtual. The selected candidate will work 100% remotely from home and can be located anywhere in the United States.

The Data Analyst I, Business Intelligence provides analytical, reporting, and business intelligence support to the Supply Management organization. The position works with data from multiple sources to develop reports, dashboards, metrics, and analyses that improve visibility into business performance and support planning and decision-making.

The Analyst assists in collecting, validating, organizing, and analyzing data; identifying trends, patterns, exceptions, and data-quality issues; and translating analytical findings into clear information for business stakeholders. The role may support analyses involving procurement spend, sourcing activity, supplier performance, contract negotiation, savings and value delivery, operational performance, market information, budgets, risks, and other Supply Management priorities.

Working under the guidance of management and more senior analysts, the Data Analyst I also supports the development and continuous improvement of business intelligence tools, reporting processes, data standards, and performance metrics. The position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical partners to understand information needs, improve data integrity, and help create scalable and repeatable analytical solutions.

Responsibilities

The Data Analyst I, Business Intelligence has responsibilities that may evolve as organizational priorities and analytical capabilities develop. Key areas of focus include, but are not limited to:

Database & System Maintenance. Support the development, updating, and maintenance of basic data systems, databases, and analytical processes within established requirements; troubleshoot coding errors and resolve routine data-related issues, escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Data Collection & Analysis. As directed, collect, mine, and analyze data from primary and secondary sources. Apply analytical and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies and develop insights that support business and procurement strategies.
Reporting & Dashboards. Develop and maintain routine reports, dashboards, and performance metrics based on defined business requirements to provide visibility into Supply Management activities and related business and operational factors that impact procurement.
Project & Operations Support. Support projects and operations through cost-benefit, variance, risk, spend, impact, and other analyses of basic complexity. Assist with feasibility studies, business case development and analysis, market research, and tracking and reporting of operational and project performance.
Data Integrity & Business Intelligence. Support senior analysts in maintaining procurement data taxonomy, data models, cost models, and business intelligence tools. Perform routine data validation, identify and help resolve data-quality issues, and improve the accuracy, consistency, and usability of information to support reliable reporting and establish a strong data foundation for advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
Stakeholder Communication. Prepare clear, user-friendly reports, visualizations, dashboards, and analytical summaries using established data and methodologies. Communicate trends, findings, and insights to Supply Management and business partners to support data-informed decision-making.

< Qualifications >

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Applied Analytics, Finance, Statistics, Business Administration or related field required.

Experience: Minimum 1 year of related experience or equivalent combination of education and related experience required.

Skills & Abilities

Working knowledge of data visualization and analytical tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Python, SQL, and Excel, with the ability to develop dashboards, analyze and transform data, and support repeatable analytical processes.
Analytical and problem-solving skills with a curious mindset and the ability to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and data-quality issues.
Basic understanding of data structures, databases, analytical methods, and data visualization principles, with strong attention to data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Effective interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, including the ability to develop clear reports, visualizations, presentations, and stakeholder communications.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage assigned priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business needs.
Ability to work effectively as part of a team, collaborate across functions, follow established requirements and methodologies, and demonstrate integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
Daily appearance on video for meetings is a requirement for this position.

Travel: Up to 25% travel may be required.

PAY INFORMATION:
The annual salary range for this position is $74,000 - $84,000. We do not offer an annual bonus for this role. Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. **We will review specific salary information at the time of phone screening based upon your location & experience.**

Benefits For You

As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:

Medical, Dental Vision plans
Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts
PTO: Starting at 15 days a year; based on type of job and tenure
Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays
401K with up to 6% match
Paid Family Leave
Employee Assistance
Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term
Service Awards and recognition

Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to

make your career a force for good!

The American Red Cross is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and any other applicable state and local laws.

new_jobs.description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the heartbeat of an e-commerce P&L, and where it's headed next.

You will own the truth behind our financial numbers and how we forecast them. We need a Financial Modeling Master who can build the forecasts our Finance team plans around, plus the predictive models that make those forecasts sharper, all grounded in rigorously reconciled data.

Additionally, you will act as a critical partner to our Finance team and leadership, bridging the gap between raw transaction data, payment processors, and the financial plan.

Develop scenario and sensitivity models that help Finance plan budgets.

Track accuracy over time and refine forecasts as the business changes.

2. Predictive Modeling

Customer & SKU-Level Models:
Build, validate, and maintain predictive models, such as subscription renewal and cancellation likelihood, refund and chargeback risk, and SKU-level demand, using statistical and machine learning methods (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis, gradient boosting).
Sharper Forecasts:
Feed model outputs into revenue and cash forecasts so projections reflect who is likely to renew, cancel, or refund, not just historical trends.
Model Health:
Monitor model performance over time and retrain as customer behavior shifts.

3. Financial Reporting & Unit Economics

P&L Reporting:
Own reporting on revenue, gross vs. net sales, discounts, refunds, COGS, and contribution margin by brand, channel, and product.
Unit Economics:
Own contribution margin, payback, and profitability reporting by brand, channel, and product.
Variance Analysis:

Description

INTERA Incorporated is seeking a senior-level Geologist and Drilling Coordinator to join its Mining and Environmental Line of Business in the Albuquerque, New Mexico office. This role leads drilling-based field events for a variety of reclamation, remediation, and environmental characterization projects. The position also supports clients in meeting regulatory requirements, restoring impacted sites, and sustainably managing natural resources.

This position will include implementing highly technical work plans for complex projects, serving as the primary link between field operations and the project manager while leading teams of personnel to conduct field and office support work for subsurface contamination investigations, geotechnical studies, groundwater monitoring well installation and development, etc. Clients include state and municipal agencies and private industries that share our values of environmental stewardship and technical excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Lead daily site activities, manage field crews, and oversee work performed by drilling contractors and subcontractors to ensure work is completed in accordance with workplans, design drawings, specifications, and client expectations.
Ensure compliance with health and safety requirements for fieldwork.
Collect environmental samples (soil/rock, aqueous, vapor), oversee drilling soil borings and monitoring well installation, and conduct hydraulic testing.
Ensure accuracy of drilling data and submit status reports to the Project Manager.
Develop cost estimates and proposals for drilling projects, including acquiring bids from multiple drilling firms and other vendors while ensuring consistency between and amongst the bids.
Plan drilling programs including resource and equipment needs, preparation of field implementation plans that reference standard operation procedures (SOPs), sampling and analysis plans, and Health and Safety plans.
Work with colleagues to ensure that the selected drilling contractor is aware of, and complies with, INTERA Statements of Work; including drilling type/style, schedule/forecast, oversight and review of drilling tickets, lithologic interpretation, geophysical logging, well construction, post-construction development, pump design and placement, aquifer testing, permanent pump design and placement, and all equipment associated with remote monitoring of the well/wellfield.
Log soil and rock core utilizing ASTM standards for lithologic interpretation and prepare boring logs.
Analyze environmental data and author detailed technical reports.
Participate in environmental site characterization investigations, including soil gas investigations, soil sampling, and groundwater sampling.
Continue to build upon and refine INTERA’s approach to drilling operations, including updating SOP’s and identifying potential inefficiencies.
Mentor junior staff and collaborate with technical teams across the company.
Support business development by maintaining client relationships and identifying new opportunities. Maintain regular contact with an ever-increasing list of drillers and related contractors.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, or related field.
10+ years of relevant professional experience with increasing levels of responsibility.
Professional licensure or willingness to obtain.
Proficiency in various borehole advancement methods, including but not limited to sonic, hollow stem auger, direct push, air rotary casing hammer, and flooded reverse circulation mud rotary.
Demonstrated experience managing drilling projects.
Strong leadership, technical report writing, problem-solving, and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex thoughts and ideas in a clear and concise manner.
General knowledge of hydrogeology, nature, and extent of contamination evaluation.
The ability to work with a project team or independently to complete technical work.
Experience developing and maintaining long-lasting relationships with drilling firms.
Experience analyzing geophysical logs.
Willingness to travel to project sites (50% - 70%) and other INTERA offices (primarily within New Mexico and Texas).

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in geology, hydrogeology, engineering, or related field.
Familiarity with state and federal environmental regulations (e.g., RCRA, CERCLA, NMED/NMAC, OSE, EPA) and risk-based criteria.
Proficiency in various environmental sampling techniques such as heated head space soil sampling, soil sampling, push-ahead groundwater sampling, and zonal groundwater sampling.
Experience with pLog and Logplot software.
Previous experience with aquifer test (Aqtesolv, nSIGHTS) and geologic modeling software (Leapfrog preferred)
OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER Certification

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Customer Data Management Specialist ensures the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and usability of customer information across NAPA systems and business processes. This role maintains and enriches customer records, supports customer onboarding, documents account relationships, and provides trusted customer data that enables effective operations and customer engagement.
The specialist works closely with Sales, Customer Service, Customer Support, Operations, Credit, Marketing, and Technology teams to resolve data issues, strengthen cross-functional handoffs, and continuously improve customer data management processes.
Position Performance Measures:

• Customer Record Accuracy and Completeness (%) - Target: 95% or higher across defined customer attributes
• Account Relationship Map Coverage (%) - Target: documented relationship maps for in-scope customer accounts
• Onboarding Data Readiness (%) - Customer records completed and validated before go-live
• Data Quality Issue Resolution - Timely correction of missing, inaccurate, duplicate, or outdated customer information
• Customer Communication Accuracy - Reduction in communications sent to incorrect or outdated customer contacts
• Customer Data Initiative Progress (%) - Assigned activities completed against approved milestones and quality expectations
Responsibilities

Customer Data Maintenance

• Clean, update, and maintain customer contact information, including email addresses, phone numbers, job titles, roles, locations, and account affiliations.
• Validate customer and account details against approved sources and correct identified inaccuracies.
• Monitor customer records for completeness, consistency, duplication, and outdated information.
• Perform routine data-quality checks and document corrections in accordance with established standards and procedures.
• Escalate systemic data issues, ownership questions, and unresolved discrepancies to the appropriate business or technology owner.
Account Research & Data Enrichment

• Conduct outreach and research using approved methods and sources to verify customer information.
• Enrich customer records with missing contact, role, account, location, hierarchy, and relationship information.
• Review conflicting information and coordinate resolution with the appropriate account owner or data steward.
• Maintain supporting documentation for material customer data updates when required.
• Help ensure customer information remains current, reliable, and usable across business processes.
Customer Onboarding Support

• Validate that required customer data fields and account relationships are complete before go-live.
• Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Support, Operations, Credit, and other stakeholders during onboarding.
• Identify and resolve onboarding risks caused by missing, inaccurate, or inconsistent customer information.
• Use approved onboarding checklists and track open data items through completion.
• Promote clear, timely handoffs between teams responsible for customer setup and ongoing account support.
Customer Data Initiative Support

• Support customer domain projects, data cleanup efforts, governance activities, and process improvement initiatives.
• Complete assigned data analysis, validation, remediation, testing, and documentation activities.
• Identify recurring data-quality issues and communicate findings, examples, and business impacts.
• Participate in root-cause analysis and recommend practical process, control, or automation improvements.
• Collaborate with business and technology teams to validate that implemented changes meet defined data requirements.
Process, Controls & Reporting

• Maintain customer data management procedures, standard work, checklists, and supporting documentation.
• Follow approved governance policies, data standards, access controls, and validation requirements.
• Track account completeness, data-quality trends, remediation progress, and recurring issues.
• Support weekly reporting and review meetings by preparing accurate status updates and performance measures.
• Protect customer information and handle data in accordance with company policies and approved procedures.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Management, Information Systems, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
• 3+ years of experience in customer data management, data quality, master data, customer onboarding, sales operations, customer support, or a related function.
• Experience maintaining customer or account records in CRM, ERP, MDM, Customer 360, or similar enterprise systems.
• Demonstrated ability to research, validate, reconcile, and accurately update customer information.
• Strong attention to detail with disciplined documentation and follow-through.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including identification of recurring data-quality issues.
• Ability to coordinate work across Sales, Customer Service, Operations, Credit, Marketing, and Technology stakeholders.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain data issues and required actions.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or data-quality tools is preferred.
• Retail, distribution, automotive aftermarket, or business-to-business customer data experience is preferred.
Success Measures

• Customer record accuracy and completeness consistently maintained at 95% or higher for defined attributes.
• In-scope customer accounts have documented and current relationship maps.
• No avoidable customer onboarding delays caused by missing or inaccurate customer data.
• Reduction in misdirected customer communications resulting from outdated contact information.
• Improved cross-functional coordination, data ownership, and handoffs during onboarding and account maintenance.
• Consistent progress against assigned customer data initiatives, remediation plans, and reporting commitments.
• Data management procedures and checklists are current, followed, and continuously improved.
Physical Demands / Working Environment

• Work is performed in a standard office or hybrid environment.
• Frequent computer-based work involving customer records, spreadsheets, business systems, and reporting tools.
• High collaboration across customer-facing, operational, data, and technology teams.
• Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities while maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.

new_jobs.description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About The Role

We are looking for a mid-level Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the heartbeat of our business operations and marketing efforts.

Because our Analytics team operates as a highly collaborative internal service department, you will act as a critical partner to three distinct functions: our Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Brand Marketing teams. You will not just analyze data; you will own the truth behind our Inventory, CS performance, and Brand Strategy. We need a versatile Data Master who understands the nuances of ERP platforms (Odoo) for inventory, ticketing platforms for CS, and the strategic planning required to support a marketing-driven Brand team.

What You’ll Do

Inventory & Supply Chain Analytics
Predictive Forecasting: Build and maintain models to predict inventory depletion rates and recommend optimal times to place additional Purchase Orders (POs) across our brand portfolio.
Platform Mastery: Ingest, clean, and analyze complex datasets from our ERP (Odoo) to provide granular insights on stock levels, lead times, and fulfillment efficiency.
Supply Chain Support: Track and report on core inventory management metrics, empowering the operations team to prevent stockouts, reduce overstock, and optimize cash flow.
Brand Strategy & Marketing Analytics
Promotion & Targeting Analysis: Partner with the Brand Marketing team to analyze the ROI of promotions, targeted campaigns, and overall brand initiatives. Help the team understand what messaging, look, and feel is resonating with our customers.
New Product Launches: Support the strategy and planning phases of new product launches by providing historical data analysis, forecasting initial demand, and tracking early performance metrics.
Strategic Planning: Empower the brand team with actionable data for audience segmentation, market positioning, and long-term marketing strategy.
Customer Service Analytics
CS Performance Tracking: Analyze data from our Customer Service platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Gorgias) to track contact rates, ticket resolution times, and customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores.
Operational Optimization: Identify friction points in the customer experience by connecting CS ticket data with fulfillment and inventory metrics, acting as the lead investigator for service-level drops.
Data Transformation & Visualization
Data Preparation: While we have a Data Engineer managing the infrastructure, you will handle the "last mile" of data prep. You will use KNIME or dbt (or similar tools like Alteryx, Tableau Prep, or Python/Pandas) to clean, merge, and format data for specific analyses.
Business Logic Application: Write efficient SQL to transform raw log-level data in Snowflake into usable datasets that reflect our specific business rules.
Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain high-impact dashboards in Sigma. You will translate complex SQL queries into visual stories tailored for specific stakeholders in Brand, CS, and Inventory.

What We’re Looking For

The Essentials (Experience & Tech Stack)

Experience Level: 3+ years of specific Data Analysis experience. (We are not looking for Junior Analysts or Senior Data Architects; we need a hands-on mid-level executor).
Industry: Proven experience in DTC E-commerce is required. You must be fluent in Shopify and Amazon Seller Central data schemas.
Warehousing & BI: Strong proficiency with Snowflake (SQL) and Sigma (building robust dashboards and workbooks).
Transformation Tools: Competency in KNIME or dbt is preferred, but we are open to candidates experienced with Alteryx, Prep, or Python who can adapt quickly.
ELT Familiarity: Awareness of how ELT tools (like Hevo, Fivetran, Airbyte, Azure, etc.) function, so you can communicate effectively with our Data Engineer when pipeline adjustments are needed.

The "Tri-Department Support" Skill Set

You are deeply versed in the ecommerce data schemas and Customer Service ticketing platforms, understanding how to extract and model complex operational data.
You have experience supporting marketing or brand teams with performance analytics, targeting metrics, and tracking the success of new product launches.
You have hands-on experience conducting inventory forecasting, PO timing predictions, and supply chain metric tracking.

The Strategic & Operations Mindset

You are comfortable bouncing between supply chain metrics (turnover ratios, lead times) and marketing metrics (conversion rates, promotion ROI).
You have the patience and precision to trace a product's lifecycle from the warehouse to the customer, while also analyzing the marketing strategies that drove the initial purchase and the customer service interactions that followed.

Generous paid time off program

Description

About Us:

PurgeRite, the leader in high-quality mechanical flushing services, is seeking highly motivated and experienced engineers. We serve all sizes of commercial mechanical companies across the U.S. with end user clients that include many top Fortune 100 companies. Projects include data centers, semiconductor and EV battery manufacturers, universities, health care facilities, and district energy systems.

Position Overview

Our customers choose PurgeRite because of our unique ability to deliver turn-key flushing solutions for some of the most complex hydronic systems being deployed today. The Project Coordinator is a key support role within the Project Management team, responsible for tracking, updating, and managing project schedules and change orders in a dynamic, fast-paced construction environment. As project timelines shift and change orders evolve, this role ensures that schedules remain up to date, change orders are properly documented, and critical project information is consistently organized. This key position is responsible for planning, executing, and closing projects while managing resources, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Project Schedule Tracking & Updates:
Maintain and update project schedules as upcoming construction project timelines shift.
Actively monitor and track schedule changes, ensuring all stakeholders are informed.
Work closely with Project Managers to ensure milestone tracking aligns with project execution and billing schedules.
Develop and enforce standardized scheduling processes in the PMO, NetSuite, MS Project, for consistency across all projects.

Change Order Management & Documentation:
Track and follow up on all change orders to ensure they are properly documented, approved, and logged.
Ensure change orders are fully executed before work is performed to mitigate financial risk.
Maintain an organized change order log, providing visibility to Project Managers and leadership pending, approved, and rejected changes.
Communicate regularly with PMs, field teams, and customers to keep change order status up to date.

Project Coordination & Process Standardization:
Support Project Managers by organizing and maintaining project documentation, including RFIs, submittals, contracts, and approvals.
Assist in defining and implementing structured processes for tracking project progress, scheduling, and change management.
Develop reporting and dashboards within VMB, MS Project & NetSuite to provide visibility into project timelines, changes, and status updates.
Ensure project tracking data remains current, reducing gaps in scheduling and billing accuracy.

Communication & Follow-Up:
Act as a liaison between Project Managers, field teams, vendors, and customers regarding scheduling updates and change orders.
Proactively follow up with internal and external stakeholders to keep schedules and change orders moving forward.
Assist in scheduling internal and external project meetings and preparing necessary reports.

Requirements

2+ years of experience in project coordination, scheduling, or construction administration.
Experience in the mechanical construction industry or large-scale construction projects is preferred.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple moving project schedules simultaneously.
Proficiency in project management software and ERP systems; experience with NetSuite is a plus. Strong Microsoft Excel skills are essential.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to follow up persistently.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment while maintaining attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

Job Description Summary

The Regional Hub Program Coordinator of Garden City provides operational and administrative support for the Thrive Kansas Digital Mental Health Initiative within an assigned Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) regional hub. This position coordinates day-to-day implementation activities, training and onboarding logistics, meeting and communication activities, documentation and record management, and project tracking. The role serves as a key resource for participating sites, community health workers (CHWs), providers, implementation partners, and regional leadership, helping ensure regional activities are completed efficiently, consistently, and in alignment with project timelines, reporting requirements, and continuous quality improvement (CQI) processes.

The Thrive Kansas Digital Mental Health Initiative is a grant funded, statewide, evidence-based digital therapeutic strategy designed to expand access to treatment for depression, substance use disorders (SUD) and other mental disorders in rural Kansas. The initiative deploys clinically validated computerized mental health interventions supported by community-based facilitation and integrated into rural primary care, behavioral health, and community settings.

Job Description

Job Description

Job Duties

Regional Deployment & Site Coordination

Track completion of regional onboarding, deployment, and access setup activities for participating sites. Maintain deployment task lists, implementation documentation, and project records.

Maintain records related to deployment activities, onboarding progress, implementation milestones, and site readiness.
Support the Regional Hub Program Manager in monitoring implementation progress, identifying potential barriers, and facilitating successful deployment activities.

Schedule and coordinate regional training sessions for providers, CHWs, supervisors, navigators, and program staff. Track training attendance, completion, certifications, and related documentation. Support onboarding and implementation activities for participating sites, organizations, and staff. Coordinate logistics and facilitate stakeholder communication to support successful adoption of digital mental health services.

About Manatee Memorial Hospital (MMH):

Manatee Memorial Hospital in Bradenton, Florida, has served the citizens of Manatee, Sarasota and surrounding counties for over 70 years. Part of the Manatee Healthcare System, the hospital has earned The Joint Commission’s Gold Seal of Approval. The 295-bed hospital with over 800 physicians, residents and allied health professionals, offers advanced healthcare services in a caring and compassionate environment. Services include cardiac care and cardiovascular medicine, emergency care for all ages, surgery services — including robotic-assisted surgery with the da Vinci® Surgical System, a weight-loss program, orthopedic services, outpatient and inpatient radiology and rehabilitation, respiratory care, sleep, oncology, wound care and women’s and children’s services. Manatee Memorial Hospital also offers a Level II Neonatal Intensive Care Unit for babies with special needs.

Position Summary:

The Pharmacy Residency Program Coordinator supports the administration and day-to-day operations of the Pharmacy Residency Program in collaboration with the Residency Program Director (RPD), Pharmacy Leadership, and Graduate Medical Education (GME). This role coordinates residency program activities, maintains program records and accreditation documentation, facilitates resident onboarding and educational activities, and supports recruitment, evaluation, and program compliance. This role will also serve the facility as the primary Internal Medicine pharmacist which entails regular interdisciplinary rounds, medication profile optimization, patient education and teaching all types of learners. The Pharmacy Residency Program Coordinator serves as a resource to residents, preceptors, pharmacy staff, and organizational departments regarding residency program requirements, schedules, and administrative processes. This role provides patient care support to the Internal Medicine team and serves as a preceptor to pharmacy students and residents. In addition, this role supports continuous program improvement and assists with activities necessary to maintain compliance with applicable accreditation and organizational standards. Demonstrates Service Excellence at all times. Other duties as assigned.

Position Information:

This position is for a full-time Pharmacy Residency Program Coordinator
Minimum of three (3) years acute care pharmacist experience
